newsitem.title: INDIA: India Colour Chem to pay 108 pct interim.
newsitem.headline: India Colour Chem to pay 108 pct interim.

text.p: The board of Colour Chem Ltd said on Thursday it has set special interim dividend at 108 rupees per 100-rupee face value stock for the year 1997/98 (April-March).
The dividend will be payable to shareholders whose names appear in the register on August 28, 1997, the firm said in a statement.
The payment is, however, subject to a receipt of 153.7 million rupees which Colour Chem is owed by DyStar India Ltd, it said.
Colour Chem had transferred its textile dyes division to DyStar India for 183.7 million rupees.
"The payment of this special interim dividend shall be made within 30 days of the receipt of such compensation," the statement said.
Colour Chem, which mainly produces specialty chemicals, is a subsidiary of Hoechst AG.
